name: Điều phối · Lõi
description: In-instance plugin for dieu-phoi-van-chuyen: deterministic driver scoring (5 weighted factors read from the customer's Cấu hình Agent tab), hard-constraint filtering, area widening, and read/write of the orders + drivers Google Sheet via the platform connector MCP. The LLM never computes scores and never marshals sheet matrices.
